_comment: Passages a person decided, on top of the ones the tools measured. Nothing regenerates
this file.
{ map, element, cell, gfx, type, skill, toMap, toCell }   declare or re-point one
{ map, element, remove: true }                            take one out
With npc set, element identifies an actor-owned route referenced by a dialogue's passage.
The actor uses its NPC template's actions; type and skill are not emitted as an interactive.
THE ASTRAL PLANE. The four arches of the Well of Dreams map and the way back from
Draconiros' room. They are not neighbours on the world grid - (0,0) and (1,-1) with
nothing between them - so without these the room is placed and unreachable, which for a
player is the same as not being there.
Every number is measured in the capture 'entrar a suenos-hablar con draconiros...':
the jss f11 gives the element, its uid and its skill; the iwo says which one the client
presses; the jru gives the destination map and the jss after it the landing cell. Four
round trips, and all four arches land on the same cell 381, all four returns on 221.
The skill is 184 and NOT the 20739-20743 of the iwo: those are instance uids. Reading
one as the other is what left the well unclickable, with no error anywhere.
THE KANOJEDO OF THE AMAKNA VILLAGE. The door of 88212247 into 99090957, 'The Kanojedo'.
The element is measured: the jss of 88212247 declares 472901 with skill 184 and the map
data puts it on cell 315, one step from where the guardian of the kanojedo stands (316).
The two doors out - 504555 and 504556, landing on 343 - were already in Giny's catalogue;
the way IN was in nobody's. The landing cell 457 is NOT measured: no capture walks through
this door. It is the walkable cell between the two doors out, so whoever comes in stands
where whoever goes out starts from.
THE GM PRISON. Its three maps, all at [66,6] in subarea 751 and joined by nothing on the
world grid, made into one round: the sky jail -> the dungeon -> the island -> the jail.
Where Ankama's own server sends them is not in the client and no capture goes there, so
the round is ours; what each end hangs off is the client's map data (bundle world_401):
105121026, the sky jail. Its one stair: the trapdoor 479454 in the middle of the
corridor, gfx 19649, drawn over cells 300, 314, 315 and 328. Down it goes to the
dungeon, landing on 370 in its big room -- the one with the cage, 92 cells; the 40
behind the bars are walled off from it.
105120002, the dungeon. Not one element on it, so its way out is a FLOOR passage, in
floor_passages.json: the cage hanging from its rope, cell 333, lifts you to the island.
105119744, the island. Its one element is the treasure chest 479462 on cell 300 (gfx
682, the chest's sprite). Opening it puts you back in the jail, on 342 at the foot of
the trapdoor.
Type -1 and skill 184, the pair every measured passage uses (TeleportContent.DefaultType
and DefaultSkill). A prisoner goes through none of them: every passage ends in
TeleportHandler.ToMapAsync, which asks the jail first.
THE ASTRUB MILITIA TOWER'S TRAINING ROOM. 192415754, the room with the puchs and their
master, at [5,-19] like the hall 192413706, and reached by nothing in any catalogue. The
hall's back wall has an arch, and under it, on cell 246, element 515569 (gfx 63584, next
to the 63583 of the street door into the hall): that is the door, landing on 423 inside
the room's two exits. Those two, 515546 on 422 and 515570 on 436, are measured in the jss
of 'bastante combate con steamer': type -1 and skill 339, 'Indicar una salida'. They lead
back to the arch, landing on 260, the hall's one walkable cell next to it. The arch's own
type and skill are the pair every measured passage uses: no capture walks through it.
THE ASTRUB BANK. Its door on the square, 191104002 [4,-18], is the vault's: element 515308 on
cell 288 (gfx 63529, at the foot of the vault door in the map data). It leads into the bank's
room, 192415750 at the same coordinates, landing on 410, beside the room's two exits. Those,
515304 on 409 and 515305 on 424 (gfx 3518, as in the Militia Tower's training room), take
skill 339, 'Indicar una salida', and lead back to 302, the square's walkable cell before the door.
While «The Tymador Job» has the smoke fairy hidden and the giant kama not yet stolen (4561..4563),
the same door leads into the smoke-filled bank, 192677890, landing on 410 as well; its two exits go
back to the square as the graph has them.
No capture goes in: the door's type and skill are the pair every measured passage uses.
THE TEMPORAL ANOMALIES' PORTALS, measured in the two anomaly captures (content/anomalies/places.json):
Noximilian's Workshop and Bonta Palace between entry and room as the iwn and the arrival cell in
the jss show them -- skill 184, type -1, where the graph has 114 and an approximate cell --, and
Qilby's place and Aguabrial's Cavern, which the graph lacks.
THE VILINSEKTS' HIDEOUTS. «Los ases del hurto» (Dofus pour les noobs: «Il suffit d'équiper la
baguette Rikiki pour entrer dans leur planque») sends the character into the tiny thieves'
hideouts. The holes (gfx 47284) are in the client's maps of the houses at [6,-15], [4,-19] (the
Council Tower) and Kerubim's shop; the graph has only the shop's, with the criterion
«POE15990,1», the rikiki wand worn, which the others are given too. The hideouts' own holes
THE COUNCIL TOWER, [4,-19]. Its ground floor, 192413702, has two staircases the map data hangs
elements on and the catalogues give no way: 515861 on 272, behind Archi (gfx 63669), and 515862
on 380, on the left (gfx 63670). Both go up to the hall, 192545798, landing on 386 beside its
stairs down (515860 on 401), which the graph already took back to 380. Dofus pour les noobs, «Ça
sent le gaz»: «Empruntez donc les escaliers situés derrière Archie afin de monter à l'étage».
Without them the hall, the Council's room and the knights' room (the forgelancers' class master)
were only reached from the vilinsekts' hideout. Type -1 and skill 184, the measured doors' pair.
THE OLD CHAPEL, [5,-15], the rogues' sanctuary 192414728. Its door on the street, 188745735, is
no element: the Astrub mercenary guarding it lets in, «Entrar en el edificio» after 50 kamas
(37072) or «Enseñarle tu carné de miembro y entrar» with the card he hands over (37075), landing
on 438 beside the two door mats. The mats, 515319 on 437 and 515331 on 452 (gfx 3507), lead back
out in front of the door, 232 -- the graph's own way out of 437 landed on 280, a cell nobody can
stand on. Skill 339, «Indicar una salida», as the bank's mats.
THE ROGUES' LAIR UNDER [5,-15], 67372032. The left edge of the sewer room 101716489 leads
there (its map change cells 280, 294 and 308), and the lair has no way out at all in the
catalogues. Its wooden door under the candlelit arch, 458840 on 241 (gfx 29474), leads back to
that sewer room, landing on 338 by the edge it came through.
ERTY TRAPCHET'S HOUSE, [1,-21], 192675844. The street's door (516016 on 283) leads in and the
stairs down to the cellar work, but nothing led back out: the door mat at the front of the room,
515271 on 374 (gfx 33069), leads to the street, landing on 297 before the door.
THE HIDDEN GLADE, [-2,-18], 192151552. «Le rebelle de la forêt»: the book under the tent of
189530123 (515999 and 516000 on cell 153, gfx 63298 and 63300) leads into the fairy Cadabrah's
glade, landing on 459; its right edge (map change cells 461-559) is the way back to the tent.
BECKY GORR'S CABIN [-2,-14]. Its door (514738) leads in to 193462272 by the world graph, which has no
way back: the doormat inside (514746, cell 411, gfx 3507, the same as the other houses' doormats with
skill 339) leads out onto 260, before the door. «L'invasion des profanateurs de sépulture» sends the
character in for Becky's lock-picking tools.
THE UNDERGROUND OF ASTRUB [1,-17]. The mine mouth of the street (element 515978) and the
three galleries behind it, [1,-17], [2,-18] and [3,-17], joined by the tunnel ends where their
rails leave the map (graphic 44035): each gallery's lower left end goes back the way it came,
its upper or right end goes on. Nothing measured them; Dofus pour les noobs sends «Cien por
cien natural» through them to the yellow puddle of [3,-17], and they are drawn as one line.
THE HIDEOUT UNDER THE QUARRY [10,-19]. Éric's old gang keeps Hicha in a room whose entrance is hidden in
the quarry (20206): element 516145 on cell 60 of 188484104, the same graphic as the room's way out
(516147, in the graph), opens into 188483080 for «Un rayon de soleil» only.
THE TURIST-A CANNON, [11,10]. Element 473019 fires the character to the isle of Moon (156762120), only with
the ticket the promoter sells for 1000 kamas (1089) and wearing a helmet (1019) and wooden wings (1021):
«il faudra vous équiper de : 1 x Ailes en bois, 1 x Casque. Ensuite, cliquez sur le canon» (Dofus pour les noobs).
THE TOMBS' ISLET [21,-12]. Its hole, element 481736 (graphic 41294) on cell 154, lets the character drop into the
underground of tombs (106697226): «Laissez vous tomber dans un trou» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Expédition culinaire»).
THE ISLE OF MOON'S WRECKS AND THE ONE-EYED'S CAVERN. The ways out of Kar Ybe's wreck [35,5] (500678) and of the
wreck on the path of skulls [32,4] (500683) lead back to the sand before their doorways, which floor_passages.json
opens; the cage door on the cave's beach [33,3] (490837, cell 95) lets whoever carries Ouily's key (17396) into his
cavern (158078210): «Entrez alors dans la Caverne du Borgne à l'aide de la clef» (Dofus pour les noobs).
THE CELESTIAL TEMPLE. Its gates, type 475 «Puertas del Templo Celeste» in the client's interactives, are the golden
door at the end of the room past the temple's book [3,3] (541737) and the same door seen from Incarnam [-2,-3], up
the floating steps (489503 at their foot): Ganymed's last word in «Réponses à tout» is «Dirigirte a la salida del
Templo Celeste», then «Le village dans les nuages» starts with Lykhen on that Incarnam map. Out, the landing is the
client's own map reference 10, cell 370, at the foot of the steps; in, the floor before the door. Whoever started
before 3.6 walks back in to the Dofusarium («en allant simplement tout au fond du Temple Céleste», Dofus pour les
noobs, «Premiers pas»).
THE HAKAM TREE'S TRUNK (subarea 464). Its maps are three blocks of 3x3 joined by their borders, the
branches (472) above them and the Canopy village (469) beside them. The 2.73 world graph goes from
the trunk to the branches through interactives the 3.6 client no longer has (434025-434034 and
435675); in their place it draws the passages of graphic 900417, on the same maps and a row higher
(cell - 14), or on the same cell. Each one leads where the old one did, landing beside the way
back (the sun, or the border the branch scrolls down by). The platform at the heart of the trunk
(24119823) has no border at all: its one way out is 537161 on cell 174, to the branch [-52,16], as
524304 was. 434028 is still there on 24118802 and leads to the branch [-55,15]. 537142, 537145 and
537147 have no counterpart in the graph and are left as scenery.
THE GARBAGE CHUTE of Bonta's palace kitchen (219284482, element 523345 on cell 328) drops into the sewers
beside Ramy (216402698), as the 2.73 world graph has it, with no criterion: «Cliquez sur la grille du vide
à ordure pour descendre dans les égouts de Bonta» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Cuisine raffinée»). INFERRED
arrival cell, beside him.
